benchmarks.rationale: 12-channel renderer gain calculation must remain a small fraction of a 256-frame real-time block.
12-channel adaptive ASRC must remain below the 5.333 ms block budget with margin for the rest of the pipeline.
Reference 12-channel 128-tap convolution must remain within a bounded software budget before true HRTF convolution lands.
The preferred contiguous transport path must remain negligible relative to the audio block budget.
